dtaCarePage.intro: DTA Care maintains, monitors and evolves the systems we build so your business keeps growing without interruptions.
dtaCarePage.item1Text: Fast, specialized assistance when something isn't working right.
dtaCarePage.item2Text: We watch your systems 24/7 to catch problems before they affect you.
dtaCarePage.item3Text: Updates and adjustments before they become a problem.
dtaCarePage.item4Text: We improve and expand your systems as your business grows.
dtaCarePage.include1: Active monitoring of uptime and errors
dtaCarePage.include4: Minor adjustments and incremental improvements included
dtaCarePage.include5: Periodic report on your systems' status
dtaCarePage.note: DTA Care is designed for systems that DTA already built or knows in depth. If your system was developed by another provider, let's start with a diagnosis to see if it applies.

auditPage.title: Discover where your business is losing time.
auditPage.intro: We analyze your processes, tools and data and build a tech roadmap for your business. You don't need to know what technology you need — we help you figure it out.
auditPage.whoText: For businesses that feel technology could help them more than it does today, but aren't sure where to start or what to build first.
auditPage.analyze1Text: How work actually flows within your operation today.
auditPage.analyze2Text: Which systems you use, which talk to each other and which don't.
auditPage.analyze3Text: Where your information lives and how accessible it is for decisions.
auditPage.receive1: Documented diagnosis of your current operation
auditPage.receive2: Identification of the top 3-5 points losing the most time or money
auditPage.receive3: Prioritized technology roadmap, with concrete next steps
auditPage.receive4: Results presentation session with your team
auditPage.process1Text: We schedule a call to understand your context.
auditPage.process2Text: We review your business's processes, tools and data.
auditPage.process3Text: We build the prioritized technology roadmap.
auditPage.process4Text: We present results and next steps with your team.
auditPage.benefit1: You'll know exactly what to automate or integrate first, without guessing.
auditPage.benefit2: You avoid investing in technology that doesn't solve your real problem.
auditPage.benefit3: You have a document to align your leadership team.
